description: Creates a workflow map using a heightmap and an optional seed map. The workflow map contains height information as well as orientation and a seed for random offset for the material it will be applied to.
name: Create Map

outputs.description: The generated workflow map, to be connected to a MixMap or an ApplyMap node
outputs.label: Output

parameters.description: The maximum height of the workflow map, used as multiplier for the input height map
parameters.label: Height
parameters.name: height

parameters.description: The angle stored in the workflow map
parameters.label: Angle
parameters.name: angle
